title: falcon.json
description: Configuration for the falcon Dart linter.

$schema.description: URL of the falcon.json JSON Schema, enabling rule autocomplete and level validation in editors.

baseline.description: Diagnostic baseline path. Relative paths resolve from the configuration files root (the current directory for user-level config). The CLI --baseline path takes precedence. Omit or use null for no baseline.

error-on-warnings.description: Fail checks on warnings as well as errors. By default, warning-only checks succeed. CLI --error-on-warnings enables this setting.

files.description: Which files falcon discovers and analyzes.

includes.description: Glob patterns relative to the configuration directory. A single star stops at directory separators; a double star crosses them. When omitted, every Dart file is a candidate.

enabled.description: Master switch for the single-file linter. Set to false to disable all file rules. Defaults to true.

domains.description: Per-domain gating for domain-scoped rules (for example Flutter rules).

flutter.description: Activation level for the `flutter` domain's rules: `all` enables every rule in the domain, `recommended` only its recommended rules, `none` disables them.

test.description: Activation level for the `test` domain's rules: `all` enables every rule in the domain, `recommended` only its recommended rules, `none` disables them.

bloc.description: Activation level for the `bloc` domain's rules: `all` enables every rule in the domain, `recommended` only its recommended rules, `none` disables them.

riverpod.description: Activation level for the `riverpod` domain's rules: `all` enables every rule in the domain, `recommended` only its recommended rules, `none` disables them.

provider.description: Activation level for the `provider` domain's rules: `all` enables every rule in the domain, `recommended` only its recommended rules, `none` disables them.

flutter_hooks.description: Activation level for the `flutter_hooks` domain's rules: `all` enables every rule in the domain, `recommended` only its recommended rules, `none` disables them.

equatable.description: Activation level for the `equatable` domain's rules: `all` enables every rule in the domain, `recommended` only its recommended rules, `none` disables them.

rules.description: Rule severity levels grouped by category, plus the `recommended` preset toggle.

recommended.description: Enable the recommended preset for this section. When on, every rule in the preset reports at its default severity unless individually overridden. Defaults to true.

cross-file.description: Cross-file (whole-project) analysis configuration. These rules scan every file and are slower than single-file rules.

enabled.description: Master switch for cross-file analysis. Set to false to disable all cross-file rules. Defaults to true.

overrides.description: Per-glob configuration overrides, applied in order to files matching their `includes`.

items.description: A single override: an `includes` glob set plus the linter/cross-file settings to apply to the matched files.

includes.description: Glob patterns relative to the configuration directory selecting the files this override applies to. Omitted patterns apply to every file.

max-errors.description: Print at most this many diagnostics without changing the exit code. Null (the default) means no limit. Must be at least 1 in configuration; use the CLI flag to hide all output.

ruleLevel.description: Severity level for a rule: `off` disables it; `on` reports at its default severity; `info`, `warn`, and `error` set an explicit severity.

ruleFix.description: Autofix policy: `none` removes fixes; `safe` or `unsafe` sets their safety classification. When omitted, inherit the previous matching policy or the rule's default classification.

overrideLinter.description: Linter settings applied by an override to its matched files.

enabled.description: Master switch for the single-file linter within this override.
